title: Abutment screw preload verification: Calculation using tightening torque, loosening torque, and screw thread pitch versus actual measurement
html: Quantifying abutment screw preload is essential in determining the risk of premature screw loosening. Currently, this is complex, requiring sophisticated measuring devices. A simplified methodology for calculating abutment screw preload has recently been proposed, but a comprehensive evaluation of its validity is lacking.
